name: retrieve_wdp_documents
description: Retrieve document/record detail from the War Data Platform for ONE ref_id previously returned by search_wdp_person or search_wdp_entity. This is the expensive, deliberate call — NEVER the first WDP call in a plan: always discover the ref_id with a cheap search tool first, then retrieve. Returns typed documents (publication, funding_record, or entity_record) with title, year, source, and a detail payload. Returns not_found for an unknown ref_id. Results are row-capped; meta.truncated signals that more documents exist than were returned.

ref_id.description: Opaque reference from a prior search_wdp_person or search_wdp_entity result. Never fabricate one.

limit.description: Maximum documents to return; the server additionally caps every response at MCP_MAX_ROWS.

detail.description: Document detail payload; long text fields are truncated per result hygiene.
